articles.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
articles.snippet: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

articles.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
articles.snippet: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

articles.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
articles.snippet: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
articles.snippet: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.
